title: Pakistan's ISI Uses Digital Honey-Trapping Against Indian Military Personnel
description:
Pakistan's ISI has modernized its espionage tactics by employing digital platforms for honey-trapping operations aimed at Indian military personnel. Recent incidents, including the arrest of an Indian Air Force officer on May 31, highlight the use of social media to build rapport and extract classified information. The officer allegedly shared sensitive documents after being lured by a woman believed to be working for the ISI. Investigators are examining how he was manipulated into leaking defense information, with multiple agencies involved in the case. The Indian government has issued advisories to military personnel to avoid using certain mobile applications that may contain spyware. This incident is part of a broader trend of honey-trapping cases that have emerged over the past decade, with a list of virtual identities used by the ISI to target military officials. The IAF has reiterated its zero-tolerance policy regarding such breaches.

Key Points:
• Pakistan's ISI employs digital honey-trapping to target Indian military personnel.
• An Indian Air Force officer was arrested for leaking sensitive information after being lured online.
• Government advisories have been issued to military personnel regarding the use of potentially compromised mobile applications.
